act: AIFC Conduct of Business Rules (COB), V17

en.title: COB 2.3.1(b) lists only COB 2.5.1 and 2.5.5 and omits Undertakings assessed under COB 2.5.6
en.summary: COB 2.3.1(b) allows a Person to be classified as a Professional Client if it meets the requirements to be an Assessed Professional Client "in accordance with COB 2.5.1 or 2.5.5". COB 2.5.1 covers individuals and 2.5.5 joint account holders. COB 2.5.6 (Undertakings with own funds of at least USD 1 million) is not listed, although 2.5.6 itself applies "For the purposes of COB 2.3.1" and the Glossary defines Assessed Professional Client by "COB 2.5.1 and 2.5.6". The words of 2.5.6 and the Glossary keep the intended meaning, but the list in 2.3.1(b) does not match them.
en.correction: Please align the list in COB 2.3.1(b) with COB 2.5.6 and the Glossary definition, for example "COB 2.5.1, 2.5.5 or 2.5.6".
